title: pauletia rufa var. intermedia
intro: Pauletia rufa var. intermedia, commonly known as Pauletia, is a species of plant in the family Malpighiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pauletia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
